basic_info.description: Welcome to 9 Shields Street  a delightful San Francisco residence where comfort meets style. This well-maintained mid-century style home greets you with natural light streaming across newly refinished hardwood floors, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout. The living room offers subtle peek-a-boo views of the ocean, while the bedrooms boast sweeping city vistas that come alive at night.    Thoughtful upgrades include a brand new electrical service panel, new rear siding, and new rear windows, ensuring both peace of mind and long-term value. Whether you're enjoying a quiet morning coffee with a view or entertaining guests in your bright and airy living space, this home delivers a perfect blend of charm, function, and San Francisco soul.    Don't miss your chance to own a slice of the city with views, light, and fresh finishes  all in one welcoming package.
